name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine found as of 19 Nov
state: An IPC alert on 12 Oct said famine risk is rising in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan as drought compounds the war, with child acute malnutrition above the Famine threshold in two East Jebel Marra camps (UN News). WFP said on 12 Nov that 900,000 people in Sudan have lost food assistance because of funding cuts (UN News). These are risk warnings, not a new Famine classification, so Watch holds.
for_you: People in Darfur and Kordofan are most exposed to starvation and disease. Readers can follow IPC and WFP updates for official classifications.
rubric_hit: 'Risk of famine' alert: IPC alert of 12 Oct for Darfur and Kordofan; no new IPC Phase 5 classification found (Watch)

sources.title: AllAfrica (UN News) — Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.
